phase.order.linear.statement: Cholec80 phases follow a broadly linear sequence from preparation to retraction

phase.transition.p5_p6_swap.statement: Gallbladder packaging (P5) and cleaning coagulation (P6) may occur in either order
phase.transition.p5_p6_swap.quote: packaging and cleaning coagulation can be inverted

phase.p6_optional.statement: Cleaning and coagulation phase (P6) is optional before final retraction
phase.p6_optional.quote: cleaning and coagulation phase may be omitted

phase.p2_duration.statement: Calot triangle dissection is typically the longest phase bounding plausible timing
phase.p2_duration.quote: calot triangle dissection is the longest phase

phase.tool_visibility.statement: A tool counts as present only if at least half its tip is visible
phase.tool_visibility.quote: at least half of the tool tip is visible

phase.clipper_in_p3.statement: Clipper is expected during clipping and cutting phase P3 and rarely elsewhere
phase.clipper_in_p3.quote: clipper is used during clipping and cutting

cvs.c1_triangle_cleared.statement: The hepatocystic triangle must be completely cleared of fat and fibrous tissue
cvs.c1_triangle_cleared.quote: all fat and fibrous tissue must be removed from the triangle of Calot

cvs.c2_lower_gb_off_plate.statement: The lower third of the gallbladder must be dissected off the cystic plate
cvs.c2_lower_gb_off_plate.quote: at least one third of the gallbladder mobilised off the cystic plate.

cvs.c3_two_structures.statement: Only two structures, and only two, should be seen entering the gallbladder
cvs.c3_two_structures.quote: 2 structures, and only 2, should be seen entering the gallbladder.

cvs.two_windows_alone.statement: Two windows alone is not CVS; the lower gallbladder must be detached from the liver bed
cvs.two_windows_alone.quote: The making of 2 “windows” alone does not satisfy the requirements of CVS.

cvs.confirmed_before_clip_cut.statement: CVS must be confirmed before any clip application or transection of tubular structures
cvs.confirmed_before_clip_cut.quote: fulfill the three criteria of CVS before dividing any structures.

cvs.doublet_documentation.statement: CVS documentation requires imaging both anterior and posterior views
cvs.doublet_documentation.quote: photographic or video documentation displaying both the **anterior** and **posterior** views of the CVS

cvs.post_clip_timing.statement: A CVS achieved claim made after clipping and cutting is temporally inconsistent
cvs.post_clip_timing.quote: to allow for reflection before “clipping, cutting or transecting any ductal structures”[84].

grade.parkland_timing.statement: Assign Parkland grade from the pre-dissection view only
grade.parkland_timing.quote: Grades the severity of cholecystitis based on initial visual inspection before dissection:

grade.nassar_cvs_prior.statement: Higher Nassar grade strongly correlates with CVS failure rate (Grade IV: 55.6%, Grade V: 92.3%)
grade.nassar_cvs_prior.quote: ability to demonstrate CVS progressively fell from 100% (grade I) to 7.7% (grade V;

grade.tokyo_not_inferable.statement: TG18 Grade II and III severity cannot be claimed from video alone without laboratory and vital signs
grade.tokyo_not_inferable.quote: severity grading is based on organ dysfunction

grade.parkland_reliability.statement: Parkland grading shows high inter-rater agreement on initial presentation view
grade.parkland_reliability.quote: The ICC among the raters of GB severity was 0.804

cond.acute_chole.visibility.statement: Acute cholecystitis displays hallmark visible signs: hyperaemia, wall edema, distension, and fluid
cond.acute_chole.visibility.quote: Gallbladder with distension/edema/thickened wall; hyperemia; adhesions obscuring the body of the gallbladder.

cond.gangrenous.necrosis.statement: Gangrenous cholecystitis is visually characterized by patchy or extensive wall necrosis
cond.gangrenous.necrosis.quote: Severe inflammation, complete adherence to the liver bed, wall necrosis/gangrene, or extensive omental wrapping.

cond.mirizzi.external_data.statement: Mirizzi syndrome type requires cholangiography or cross-sectional imaging and cannot be fully staged from video
cond.mirizzi.external_data.quote: mirizzi syndrome requires preoperative or intraoperative cholangiography

cond.cancer.not_inferable.statement: Malignancy or gallbladder cancer cannot be confirmed without histopathology

anatomy.rha_crossing.statement: Right hepatic artery crosses the hepatocystic triangle in 15% and must not be mistransected
anatomy.rha_crossing.quote: 15% of right hepatic arteries course through the triangle and can be mistaken

anatomy.caterpillar_hump.statement: Caterpillar hump (Moynihan hump) occurs in up to 13.3% and poses high risk of accidental clipping
anatomy.caterpillar_hump.quote: caterpillar hump of the right hepatic artery

anatomy.rouviere_sulcus.statement: Rouviere sulcus is identifiable in 83% of livers and marks the safe plane anterior to the hilum
anatomy.rouviere_sulcus.quote: identified a prevalence of 83% of Rouviere’s sulcus

anatomy.r4u_line_safety.statement: Dissection below the R4U line (Segment 4 to Rouviere sulcus) enters the hazardous hilar zone
anatomy.r4u_line_safety.quote: it is vital to dissect at a location above

anatomy.short_cystic_duct.statement: A short cystic duct increases the risk of tenting and transecting the common bile duct
anatomy.short_cystic_duct.quote: short cystic duct leads to tenting of common bile duct

finding.smoke_evacuation.statement: Electrocautery smoke obscuring visual clarity should be evacuated before critical dissection
finding.smoke_evacuation.quote: evacuation of smoke to maintain clear visualization

finding.perforation_spillage.statement: Gallbladder perforation leads to bile and gallstone spillage requiring peritoneal lavage
finding.perforation_spillage.quote: * **Stone and Bile Spillage:** Gallbladder perforation with lost gallstones

finding.distension_decompression.statement: A tense distended gallbladder may require needle decompression before safe grasping
finding.distension_decompression.quote: A tense gallbladder (acute cholecystitis, empyema, mucocele) was decompressed.

implication.bailout_subtotal.statement: When severe inflammation prevents safe CVS attainment, bail out with subtotal cholecystectomy

implication.subtotal_types.statement: Subtotal fenestrating carries higher bile leak risk, while reconstituting risks recurrent stones
implication.subtotal_types.quote: After a fenestrating subtotal cholecystectomy, the risk is higher for a significant bile leak

decision.difficulty_assessment.statement: Operative difficulty should be formally assessed from pre-dissection anatomical appearance.
decision.difficulty_assessment.quote: early recognition of difficulty and identification of cholecys- tectomies

decision.exposure_retraction.statement: Hepatocystic triangle exposure requires fundus retracted cephalad and infundibulum retracted laterally.
decision.exposure_retraction.quote: Retract fundus cephalad and infundibulum laterally to expose hepatocystic triangle

decision.dissection_plane_r4u.statement: Dissection in Calot triangle must stay above the R4U line to protect common bile duct.
decision.dissection_plane_r4u.quote: Dissect above the line from the base of Segment 4 to Rouvière sulcus

decision.cvs_pause.statement: A deliberate pause must be taken to verify all three CVS criteria prior to clipping.
decision.cvs_pause.quote: “momentary intraoperative pause” to allow for reflection before “clipping, cutting or transecting

decision.cvs_not_reached_action.statement: When CVS cannot be reached safely, obtain imaging, call for assistance, or prepare bailout.
decision.cvs_not_reached_action.quote: A bail-out procedure should be chosen if

decision.bailout_choice.statement: Subtotal cholecystectomy is preferred over fundus-first cholecystectomy in hostile gallbladders.
decision.bailout_choice.quote: Prefer subtotal over fundus-first total cholecystectomy when CVS cannot be achieved

decision.clip_and_divide.statement: The cystic duct and artery should be clipped only after full CVS confirmation.
decision.clip_and_divide.quote: Use CVS to identify the cystic duct and artery before dividing

decision.gb_bed_haemostasis.statement: The gallbladder bed should be dissected cleanly off cystic plate and inspected for bleeding or bile leak.
decision.gb_bed_haemostasis.quote: Inspect the gallbladder fossa for bleeding and bile leak prior to completion
